about: modules/git G-ORACLE mutants: hermetic environment isolation, deterministic fixed-clock timestamps, NUL-delimited (-z) plumbing parsing, and typed transcript comparison.

mutants.name: git-oracle-inherits-ambient-config
mutants.rule: HermeticEnv isolates C Git from ambient HOME/.gitconfig, global config, attributes, and ambient identity overrides.

mutants.name: git-oracle-uses-wall-clock
mutants.rule: HermeticEnv pins GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE to the deterministic step epoch rather than wall-clock time.

mutants.name: git-oracle-drops-z-nul-parse
mutants.rule: NUL-delimited (-z) plumbing parsers split records on NUL bytes rather than newlines.

mutants.name: git-oracle-compare-ignores-oid
mutants.rule: CompareTranscripts compares Final.HeadOid and reports typed mismatches on differing repository outcomes.

mutants.name: git-locks-publishes-before-sync
mutants.rule: In Durable mode, Commit calls SyncFile before RenamePublish (NoPublishBeforeSync).

mutants.name: git-locks-unlinks-unowned-lock
mutants.rule: When Acquire fails with LockHeld, the loser never unlinks the winner's lock file.

mutants.name: git-locks-swallows-dirsync-error
mutants.rule: When SyncDir fails after RenamePublish in Durable mode, Commit surfaces DirSyncUncertain instead of reporting success.

mutants.name: git-locks-allows-overwrite-acquire
mutants.rule: HostLockOps.CreateExclusive uses O_CREAT|O_EXCL rather than truncating create so rival holders cannot overwrite a live lock.

mutants.name: git-root-reverses-config-scope
mutants.rule: Config scope precedence orders System < Global < Local < Worktree < Command so Local overrides Global.

mutants.name: git-root-ignores-commondir
mutants.rule: Discover resolves commondir for linked worktrees rather than returning GitDir as CommonDir.

mutants.name: git-root-ignores-unknown-extension
mutants.rule: Discover rejects unknown extensions.* under repositoryformatversion = 1 with UnsupportedExtension.

mutants.name: git-root-follows-untrusted-include
mutants.rule: LoadConfigFiles does not follow include.path directives when TrustPolicy.AllowIncludes is false.

mutants.name: git-oid-omits-nul
mutants.rule: Canonical Git object headers terminate `<kind> <size>` with a NUL byte before payload bytes.

mutants.name: git-oid-normalizes-crlf
mutants.rule: HashObject hashes raw object payload bytes without CRLF/line-ending conversion.

mutants.name: git-oid-accepts-uppercase-hex
mutants.rule: ParseHex enforces strict canonical lowercase hex and rejects uppercase hex digits.

mutants.name: git-deltas-ofs-bias-off-by-one
mutants.rule: ParseOfsDistance applies Git's +1 bias on each OFS_DELTA continuation byte before shifting left by 7.

mutants.name: git-deltas-zero-copy-size-not-64k
mutants.rule: Apply treats a zero-encoded copy instruction size as 0x10000 (65,536) bytes per Git delta format.

mutants.name: git-deltas-ignore-base-size-mismatch
mutants.rule: Apply rejects deltas whose decoded base size does not match len(base) with BaseSizeMismatch.

mutants.name: git-deltas-allow-opcode-zero
mutants.from: return CorruptDelta{Offset: cmdPos, Reason: "reserved delta opcode 0x00"}
mutants.rule: Apply strictly rejects reserved delta opcode 0x00 with CorruptDelta rather than ignoring it.

mutants.name: git-packidx-swap-large-offset-index
mutants.rule: Pack index v2 resolves MSB-set 32-bit offsets through the 64-bit large-offset table rather than returning the table index as a pack offset.

mutants.name: git-packidx-ignore-checksum
mutants.rule: Pack index parsing verifies the trailing index checksum over all preceding bytes.

mutants.name: git-packidx-accept-unknown-version
mutants.rule: Pack index v2+ headers with unknown versions are rejected with UnsupportedVersion rather than parsed optimistically.

mutants.name: git-packidx-off-by-one-fanout
mutants.to: let mut hi = if idx.fanout[b] > uint32(0) { int(idx.fanout[b]) - 1 } else { 0 }
mutants.rule: Pack index binary search uses the exact exclusive upper bound fanout[b] for bucket b.

mutants.name: git-refs-packed-shadows-loose
mutants.rule: Loose references take precedence over packed-refs entries.

mutants.name: git-refs-ignores-symref-cycle
mutants.rule: Resolve detects symbolic reference cycles immediately and returns CyclicSymref with the exact cycle chain.

mutants.name: git-refs-drops-peeled-tag
mutants.rule: ParsePackedRefs attaches ^<oid> peeled tag targets to the immediately preceding annotated tag ref.

mutants.name: git-refs-allows-dotdot-name
mutants.rule: ValidateRefName rejects ref names containing '..' per Git check-ref-format rules.

mutants.name: git-loose-wrong-fanout
mutants.rule: Loose object fanout path splits the hex OID at 2/38 (or 2/62) characters.

mutants.name: git-loose-collapses-corrupt-to-missing
mutants.rule: Corrupt loose objects fail with Corrupt rather than collapsing into Missing.

mutants.name: git-loose-skips-rehash-verify
mutants.rule: DecodeAndVerify rehashes decoded bytes under id.Format and rejects mismatches as Corrupt.

mutants.name: git-loose-ignores-alternates
mutants.rule: Loose object reads search both primary ObjectsDir and configured Alternates in order.

mutants.name: git-pack-stale-miss-no-refresh
mutants.rule: ODB refreshes its pack catalog on lookup miss so a handle opened before git repack -ad never returns stale Missing results.

mutants.name: git-pack-accept-mismatched-pair
mutants.rule: ValidatePackPair verifies the packfile trailing checksum equals packidx.PackChecksum(idx) and rejects mismatches with MismatchedPair.

mutants.name: git-pack-skip-alternates
mutants.rule: ODB searches primary and alternate object directories for both packs and loose objects.

mutants.name: git-pack-skip-oid-rehash
mutants.rule: verifyPackedOID rehashes materialized packed object bytes under reqOid.Format and rejects digest mismatches as Corrupt.

mutants.name: git-index-overwrite-stage-on-dup-path
mutants.rule: Index entries are ordered and keyed by (Path, Stage) so distinct conflict stages on the same path do not collide or overwrite each other.

mutants.name: git-index-accept-unknown-mandatory-ext
mutants.rule: Unknown lowercase (mandatory) Git index extensions are rejected with UnsupportedMandatoryExtension.

mutants.name: git-index-wrong-v4-varint
mutants.rule: Index v4 path prefix-strip varint uses Git OFS-style +1 continuation bias.

mutants.name: git-index-ignore-checksum
mutants.rule: Git index decoding verifies the trailing digest checksum over all preceding bytes.

mutants.name: git-tree-lex-sort-instead-of-slash
mutants.from:
let ca = if n < len(ab) { int(ab[n]) } else if aIsTree { 47 } else { 0 }
	let cb = if n < len(bb) { int(bb[n]) } else if bIsTree { 47 } else { 0 }
mutants.to:
let ca = if n < len(ab) { int(ab[n]) } else { 0 }
	let cb = if n < len(bb) { int(bb[n]) } else { 0 }
mutants.rule: CompareEntryNames compares Git tree directory entries as if followed by '/' (0x2f) rather than plain lexicographical order.

mutants.name: git-tree-drop-octopus-parents
mutants.rule: ParseCommit preserves all parent headers including 2+ parents on merge and octopus-merge commits.

mutants.name: git-tree-recurse-gitlink
mutants.from:
case ModeGitlink:
			out = out.Append(WalkEntry{
				Path: fullPath,
				Mode: ModeGitlink,
				Kind: oid.Commit,
				OID:  e.OID,
				Size: None,
			})
mutants.to:
case ModeGitlink:
			out = try walkTreeRec(format, e.OID, fullPath, depth+1, maxDepth, maxBytes, withSizes, out)
mutants.rule: WalkTree emits 160000 gitlink entries as leaf commits without descending into them.

mutants.name: git-tree-allow-leading-zero-tree-mode
mutants.rule: ParseTree rejects leading-zero "040000" raw tree entry modes per git fsck.

mutants.name: git-graph-bloom-false-negative
mutants.rule: Changed-path Bloom filter probing uses exact Git Murmur3 double-hashing (h0 + i*h1) % numBits so touched paths never produce false negatives.

mutants.name: git-graph-drop-octopus-edge
mutants.rule: Commit-graph decoding expands MSB-set parent2 indices through the EDGE chunk to preserve all octopus merge parents.

mutants.name: git-graph-ignore-checksum
mutants.rule: Commit-graph parsing verifies the trailing checksum over all preceding bytes.

mutants.name: git-graph-wrong-base-chain-offset
mutants.rule: Split commit-graph chains offset each layer's local commit indices by the cumulative commit count of preceding base layers.
